facts.fact: Ila's survey spike fell into the meltwater hollow inside the Eye's cleft mouth and is lost; without it she cannot anchor her chain.
The ice curtain hides the cleft's true walls; Ila gets the left wall's half-width only and marks the right wall 'not measured' on her sheet.
Kunal names the garrison cost aloud (twenty men on the shelf, a fire on the tongue, sentries along the shore) before telling Ila to draw it true.
